Screening Laboratory Eligibility Confirmation
data.description: Screening labs reviewed at Visit 2 to confirm eligibility; Visit 2 may occur as soon as criteria for Visit 1 are confirmed
data.text: Visit 2 may occur as soon as the criteria for Visit 1 are confirmed. At Visit 2, screening laboratory results will be reviewed to confirm eligibility.

data.name: HbA1c Eligibility Range
data.description: Central laboratory HbA1c at Visit 1 within protocol range
data.text: HbA1c ≥7.0% (53 mmol/mol) to ≤9.5% (80 mmol/mol), as determined by the central laboratory at Visit 1 (screening).

data.name: Pre-Randomization Eligibility Reconfirmation
data.description: Inclusion/exclusion criteria must be confirmed prior to randomization and first dose
data.text: Confirm inclusion and exclusion criteria prior to randomization and administration of first dose of study intervention.

data.name: Ophthalmologic Eligibility Confirmation
data.description: Eligibility per exclusion criterion 13 must be confirmed based on fundus photographs and any additional ophthalmological evaluation
data.text: Eligibility (see exclusion criterion 13, Section 5.2) MUST be confirmed based on fundus photographs and any additional ophthalmological evaluation needed.

data.name: Retinopathy/DME Present at Baseline
data.description: Determines whether Week 24 follow-up fundus photography is performed
data.text: Perform follow-up fundus photography and any additional ophthalmological evaluation at Week 24 (±4 weeks) only if retinopathy or DME were present at baseline.

data.name: Pregnancy Test Result Before First Dose
data.description: Urine pregnancy test result must be available before first dose for WOCBP; additional tests if missed menses or clinical suspicion
data.text: The result must be available before the first dose of study intervention for WOCBP. Perform additional pregnancy tests if a menstrual period is missed, if there is clinical suspicion of pregnancy, or as required by local law or regulation.

data.name: Non-Fasting Attendance at Fasting Visit
data.description: Visit must be rescheduled within the allowable visit interval if participant attends a fasting visit non-fasting
data.text: If a participant attends a fasting visit in the non-fasting state, reschedule the visit at a time within the allowable visit interval.

data.name: Hepatic Laboratory Criteria for Interruption/Discontinuation
data.description: Hepatic lab thresholds triggering study drug interruption or discontinuation in participants with elevated baseline hepatic values
data.text: ALT or AST ≥2x baseline or ≥250 U/L (whichever occurs first) and TBL ≥2x ULN or INR ≥1.5.

data.name: BMI ≤20 kg/m2 or Perceived Excessive Weight Reduction
data.description: Triggers dose reduction consideration and weight monitoring after dose reduction
data.text: Management of participants with BMI ≤20 kg/m2 or perceived excessive weight reduction, including recommendation for monitoring weight after dose reduction.

data.name: Poor Nutrition or Dehydration
data.description: Participants with or at risk of poor nutrition or dehydration are managed per Appendix 11, including possible dose modification or discontinuation
data.text: Added the option of dose modification for participants with poor nutrition or dehydration; management per Section 6.6.2 and Appendix 11.

data.name: Severe Persistent Hyperglycemia
data.description: Condition triggering rescue therapy for glycemic control
data.text: Rescue Therapy for Severe Persistent Hyperglycemia (Section 6.9.4).

data.name: Pregnancy During Study
data.description: Female participant becoming pregnant must discontinue study intervention and be withdrawn from the study
data.text: Any female participant who becomes pregnant while participating in the study will discontinue study intervention and will be withdrawn from the study.

data.name: Calcitonin Threshold (Exclusion/Monitoring)
data.description: Calcitonin values reported in pg/mL (Conventional) and pmol/L (SI) used for thyroid C-cell monitoring and exclusion criterion 24
data.text: Updated calcitonin units from 'ng/L' to 'pg/mL (Conventional) and pmol/L (SI)' in Exclusion Criterion 24 and in Section 8.3.3.8.

data.name: Early Discontinuation at or Before Week 4
data.description: DID-EQ is collected at the ED visit only if discontinuation occurs at or before Week 4
data.text: DID-EQ: At ED if discontinuation is at or before Week 4.

data.name: Waiver of Safety Follow-up Visit
data.description: Participants who discontinued intervention early and only willing to return for Visit 11 are not required to complete safety follow-up if off drug ≥28 days
data.text: Participants who have discontinued study intervention early and are only willing to come back for Visit 11 (Week 40) are not required to complete a safety follow-up visit if they have been off of study intervention for at least 28 days.

data.name: Visit Procedures Spanning Multiple Days
data.description: Visit procedures may be split across days if completed within the allowed visit tolerance
data.text: Visit procedures may be conducted over more than 1 day if all activities are completed within the allowed visit tolerance period of each visit.

data.name: Exceptional Circumstances Handling
data.description: Alternative SoA guidance applies for participants affected by pandemics or natural disasters
data.text: For those participants whose participation in this study is affected by exceptional circumstances, such as pandemics or natural disasters, refer to Section 10.14 for additional guidance.

data.name: Unscheduled Immunogenicity Sampling Trigger
data.description: Additional immunogenicity samples collected for hypersensitivity or injection site reactions
data.text: Collect additional unscheduled samples if systemic drug hypersensitivity reactions (immediate or nonimmediate) or injection site reactions occur (severe or recurrent).

data.name: Screening to Treatment Period Transition
data.text: Inclusion/exclusion criteria confirmed at Visits 1, 2 and 3; Visit 3 to occur no sooner than 18 days after Visit 1 (screening up to 4 weeks); randomization via IWRS at Visit 3 with all assessments completed before the first dose.

data.name: Treatment Period to Safety Follow-up Transition
data.text: A posttreatment safety follow-up visit (Visit 801) will occur approximately 4 weeks following the last treatment period visit (Visit 11, Week 40).

data.name: Permanent Discontinuation of Study Intervention
data.text: Permanent discontinuation from study intervention per Section 7.1.1, including new criterion for participants with poor nutrition or dehydration.

data.name: Hepatic Criteria for Interruption or Discontinuation
data.text: ALT or AST ≥2x baseline or ≥250 U/L (whichever occurs first) and TBL ≥2x ULN or INR ≥1.5 requires study drug interruption/discontinuation with close hepatic monitoring; monitoring frequency may be lowered to once every 1 to 2 weeks if clinical condition and labs stabilize.

data.name: Discontinuation and Withdrawal for Pregnancy
data.text: Any female participant who becomes pregnant while participating in the study will discontinue study intervention and will be withdrawn from the study.

data.name: Temporary Interruption of Study Intervention
data.text: Temporary interruption of study intervention for gastrointestinal tolerability or for reasons unrelated to gastrointestinal tolerability (Sections 6.6.4, 7.1.3).

data.name: Blinded Dose Modification via IWRS
data.text: All dose adjustments are managed through IWRS in a blinded fashion (Section 6.6).

data.name: Dose Reduction for BMI ≤20 kg/m2 or Excessive Weight Reduction
data.text: Dose reduction for participants with BMI ≤20 kg/m2 or perceived excessive weight reduction, with recommended weight monitoring after dose reduction.

data.name: Dose Modification for Poor Nutrition or Dehydration
data.text: Option of dose modification for participants with poor nutrition or dehydration per Section 6.6.2 and Appendix 11.

data.name: Rescue Therapy for Severe Persistent Hyperglycemia
data.text: Rescue therapy/rescue medication may be initiated for severe persistent hyperglycemia (Sections 6.9.4 and 6.9.5); initiation of additional antihyperglycemic medication is an ICE for the efficacy estimand.

data.name: Symptomatic Medication for GI Symptoms
data.text: Symptomatic medication may be used for gastrointestinal symptoms (Section 6.9.6); routinely assess the need to adjust or discontinue anti-emetics and laxatives.

data.name: Concomitant Medication Adjustment
data.text: Monitor closely and routinely assess the need to adjust or discontinue antihypertensive medications, diuretics, lipid-lowering agents, laxatives, and anti-emetics (Sections 6.9.1 and 10.10).

data.name: Early Discontinuation Visit Transition
data.text: For early discontinuation that occurs before the last visit in treatment period, perform the activities listed for ED in the SoA.

data.name: Early Discontinuation (ED) Visit
data.description: Participants who discontinue before the last treatment period visit complete the ED visit assessments listed in the SoA (including DID-EQ if discontinuation is at or before Week 4).

data.name: Participant Discontinuation/Withdrawal from Study
data.description: Participant discontinuation/withdrawal from the study per Section 7.2, including withdrawal following pregnancy.

data.name: Lost to Follow-up
data.description: Participants lost to follow-up are handled per Section 7.3.

data.name: Study Completion
data.description: Completion of the 40-week treatment period (Visit 11, Week 40) and the 4-week safety follow-up visit (Visit 801), with eDiary return at the last visit.

data.name: Safety Follow-up Not Required
data.description: Participants who discontinued study intervention early, are only willing to return for Visit 11 (Week 40), and have been off study intervention for at least 28 days exit without a safety follow-up visit.

data.name: Screening Eligibility Confirmation Decision
data.description: At Visit 2, screening laboratory results, fundus photography, and other screening data are reviewed to confirm eligibility.

data.name: Randomization Decision
data.description: At Visit 3 (Week 0), inclusion/exclusion criteria are reconfirmed and pregnancy test results must be available before randomization via IWRS and first dose.

data.name: Week 24 Ophthalmologic Reassessment Decision
data.description: Follow-up fundus photography at Week 24 (±4 weeks) is performed only if retinopathy or DME were present at baseline.

data.name: PK Sampling Window Assignment Decision
data.description: At Weeks 7, 15, and 19, PK samples are collected only in the time window (1-24 hr, 24-96 hr, or 120-168 hr post dose) assigned by IWRS.

data.name: Hepatic Safety Decision
data.description: Decision to interrupt or permanently discontinue study intervention and determine hepatic monitoring frequency based on ALT/AST, TBL, and INR values.

data.name: Dose Modification Decision for Nutrition/Weight
data.description: Decision to reduce dose, interrupt, or discontinue study intervention for BMI ≤20 kg/m2, perceived excessive weight reduction, poor nutrition, or dehydration.

data.name: Early Discontinuation Assessment Decision
data.description: At the ED visit, DID-EQ is administered only if discontinuation occurs at or before Week 4.

data.name: Safety Follow-up Visit Requirement Decision
data.description: Determination of whether Visit 801 is required based on early discontinuation status and ≥28 days off study intervention.
